visual_action: A montage of images and short clips of Robert F. Kennedy Jr. The montage includes a formal portrait, a selfie-style video of him outdoors, him shirtless in a stream, him posing with a dead bear, him holding a large roasted animal carcass, and him speaking at a hearing. The montage also includes an infographic chart titled "Unvaccinated Drive Worst Single Measles Outbreak Since 2000" with statistics for "Measles cases in the United States in 2025". A text overlay is present throughout the entire video.

intended_effect: To portray Robert F. Kennedy Jr. as unfit for office and to generate alarm and ridicule towards him and the prospect of him serving in a Trump administration.
